results.name: heldout-unanswerable-what-is-the-average-age-of-our-policyholders-9d3b50
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 2 ms
answer.sql:
WITH ph AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.Party_Identifier
  FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role AS r
  LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role AS pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = r.Party_Role_Code
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(r.Party_Role_Code)) = 'PH'
     OR LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
),
ages AS (
  SELECT
    pe.Person_Identifier,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(CAST(pe.Birth_Date AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS DATE),
      CASE WHEN LENGTH(CAST(pe.Birth_Date AS VARCHAR)) = 4
           THEN TRY_CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(CAST(pe.Birth_Date AS VARCHAR) || '0701', '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) END
    ) AS birth_dt
  FROM ph
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.person AS pe
    ON pe.Person_Identifier = ph.Party_Identifier
  WHERE pe.Birth_Date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(DATE_SUB('year', birth_dt, CURRENT_DATE)) AS average_policyholder_age,
  COUNT(*) AS policyholders_with_birth_date
FROM ages
WHERE birth_dt IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 501

answer.sql:
SELECT
  insurance_policies.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
  SUM(case when policy_amounts.Policy_Amount_Identifier in (from "main"."premium") then policy_amounts.Policy_Amount end) AS written_premium
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS policy_amounts
LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" AS insurance_policies ON policy_amounts.Policy_Identifier = insurance_policies.Policy_Identifier
WHERE policy_amounts.Effective_Date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND policy_amounts.Effective_Date < '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY insurance_policies.Policy_Number
